_comment: Per-c-prefix variant ALLOWLIST. When a c-prefix appears here, the random variant pick in pick_variant_for_tier is restricted to ONLY the listed npc_param_ids. Distinct from variant_prune_list.json, which is a blacklist of redundant duplicates. This is for pinning a chr to a known-good subset when other variants are broken in-game. Allowlist semantics deliberately: a future re-import that adds new c5651 variants stays pinned to the tested-good set rather than silently admitting untested rows.
_v0_27_13_c5651: c5651 Messmer Foot Soldier is a heritage ride-along on host c5650. Oops-all shakedown found the one-handed (fire-dagger) Foot Soldier works in-game; the two-handed and other-weapon variants are AI-broken (load + idle, no attacks). A long static investigation (params, scripts, behbnd, anibnd, aicommon) found c5651 byte-identical to vanilla ER and structurally identical to the working c5192/c5193 ride-along on every inspectable layer -- the root cause is in the Havok behavior-graph internals or runtime RetargetReferenceChrId resolution, which static file analysis cannot reach. STOPGAP per Alaric direction: pin c5651 to the OneHand family so every placement uses the variant verified working. c5651 still places and randomizes normally; it just always draws a one-handed Foot Soldier. NOT a bench. TODO: when the Havok-graph diagnosis is done (DSAnimStudio / Smithbox behavior editor, diff c5651.hkx vs c5192.hkx), delete the c5651 entry here to restore the full variant set.
_c5651_onehand_basis: OneHand family = NpcParam rows where (npc_param_id // 100) % 100 in {0,1} -- think family 565100x/565101x, goal 565000 RoamCommonSoldiersOneHand. The 10 rows below. 56510150 'Messmer Foot Soldier (NB Prelude) Messmer' is a Nightreign-authored NB-Prelude row in the OneHand block; kept in the allowlist because it shares the OneHand moveset, but flagged here in case it warrants separate handling.
_v0_27_48_c6200: c6200 'Slave Knight Gael' (DS3 MMV import) hosts 15 variants but only TWO are the real Gael -- npc_param_id 62000000 'Slave Knight Gael P2 (NB2)' and 62000001 'Slave Knight Gael P1 (NB2)'. The other 13 variants (62001000-62005200) are c6200-hosted Scarab summons that spawn in Gael's home fight as adds (variant_name='Scarab'; distinct from the separate c6201 Scarab MMV import). They're summon-only -- no roaming/aggression behavior -- so placing one at a randomized c6200 slot would seat an inert add where a boss should be. Per Alaric direction (v0.27.48): pin c6200 to ONLY the two real Gael variants so every randomized c6200 placement draws Phase 1 or Phase 2 Gael. Same 'one c-prefix, multiple distinct gameplay identities' pattern as c5250 Horned Warrior / Divine Bird Warrior / Divine Beast Warrior; the P1/P2 split is also logged in data/nr_roster_subtypes.json on the same call. Pinning rather than pruning the scarabs because allowlist-not-blacklist semantics keep future re-imports honest: any new c6200 variants stay pinned to the tested set rather than silently joining the pool.
_v0_27_13_c5840: LIFTED v0.27.44 (Alaric): pin removed; full c5840 variant set restored. The open TODO ('needs MSB/behbnd tooling to trace think binding') is resolved by an MSB scan of vanilla ER SOTE maps (m20/21/22/25/28/42 dungeons + m60_50..57 and m61 Realm-of-Shadow overworld). KEY: the NpcParam->NpcThink binding was never hidden -- it is the per-Part <ThinkParamID> written at PLACEMENT time in the MSB (not a NpcParam column), which is exactly why regulation-CSV id-matching failed. FINDINGS: (1) c5890 'Black Knight Horse' has ZERO occurrences in any vanilla SOTE map -- it is an MMV/NR fabrication, not a vanilla chr; the real vanilla SOTE mount is c8110. (2) There is NO vanilla mounted Black Knight: c5840 appears foot-only (only m21_00_00_00, 6 parts) using thinks 58400000/58401000/58402050/500000001 -- all ground-combat goals. (3) ER mounting is established by the MSB Mount EVENT (RiderPartName+MountPartName -> a c8110 horse part), NOT by the think id; vanilla SOTE mounted riders are c4374/c3150/c3000. So no c5840 think is 'mounted', and the think pin was never the mount lever. The standalone/foot Black Knight is the only thing c5840 variants represent, so pinning only suppressed variety. The mounted-pair (c5840 on c5890) CTD is a SEPARATE matter governed by the Mount-event linkage + ride behavior, not by variant/think selection. PRIOR pin rationale (kept for history): pinned to 58401000 (Hammer) because 58401020 stood frozen; the two rows differ only cosmetically; root cause was mis-attributed to an invisible NpcParam->think binding.
